Modifications for Glon AvP:
- converted to 16-bit mono PCM at 44,100 Hz for the existing mixer;
- loop crossfade of 1.0 s applied by the runtime, shortening the played loop

- no other processing, regeneration or additional layers.

The converted runtime file is `ambient_loop.wav`
(1,499,403 frames, 2,998,920 bytes;

The previous synthetic G5y ship/ventilation loops were removed and are not
layered under this recording.
